decision.note: Current Kew/POWO accepts Opuntia phaeacantha and lists Texas as native. Older Central Texas records under the phaeacantha name cannot safely be converted into three exact modern-concept target counties because Texas Opuntia treatments have split historical phaeacantha material among taxa including O. camanchica, O. gilvescens and related concepts. Preserve the Hays source row and historical Travis/Williamson evidence as concept evidence, not a strict 3-county PASS.

field_note: Brown-spine/desert pricklypear concept: low to spreading pads, usually conspicuous brown-gray spines, yellow flowers often with reddish bases, fleshy reddish-purple fruit. Use pad/spine/fruit characters only after resolving the taxon concept.
learner_guardrail: Do not install as a project-native learner until three exact target-zone counties are documented under the current accepted O. phaeacantha concept. Do not merge older broad-name records automatically.
